subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Kalan Strongbranch's firing
fact: Kalan Strongbranch was fired — a man told he was done, standing next to a case he couldn't crack, that we cracked for him.
source_quote: Kalan had gotten fired. That's the terrain — a man told he was done, standing next to a case he couldn't crack, that we cracked for him.

subject: Dawnbringer's therapy request
fact: Dawnbringer requested therapy — she said, 'I'm not leaving here without the therapy. That first session was actually very productive.'
source_quote: She spoke up in my head. *I'm not leaving here without the therapy. That first session was actually very productive. I really feel we need to—*

subject: Bookwyrm's potential dismissal
fact: Bookwyrm may be dismissed from her position due to suspicion, with the new head of Candlekeep likely to demand a Zone of Truth as her first act.
source_quote: The new head may give Bookwyrm one of two choices: continue as a member of the Avowed, or submit to a Zone of Truth.

subject: Alkrist's confession
fact: Alkrist confessed to killing Janussi under Kalan's spell, and the confession was deemed insufficient by academic standards despite being legally valid.
source_quote: Alkrist had confessed. Kalan Strongbranch hadn't yet come back into the room, and we knew there was a thread running from all this back to A'lai.

subject: Kalan's academic paper
fact: Kalan's paper argues that a single source of truth (like a confession) is insufficient — three different kinds of evidence are required.
source_quote: My paper says you can't rely on one source of truth; you need three different kinds.

subject: Candlekeep naming ceremony
fact: A naming ceremony for the new head of Candlekeep will occur tomorrow, and Bookwyrm is expected to be passed over.
source_quote: Tomorrow there will be a naming ceremony — and with all of this suspicion over her name, the confession, the information… the vote will go elsewhere.

subject: Zone of Truth spell mechanics
fact: The Zone of Truth spell does not guarantee truth — it reveals whether the target can lie, making resistance detectable.
source_quote: The spell doesn't hand you the truth. It hands you the ability to watch someone refuse it.

subject: Daz's contingency plan
fact: Daz's contingency plan is to 'start hacking and slashing' if things go sideways — a comfort, not a strategy.
source_quote: If things go sideways, we can always start hacking and slashing.

subject: Ember Vanguard's infamy
fact: The Ember Vanguard is infamous underground, with a legend that walks ahead of the party in every rumor, bigger and meaner than the four of them.
source_quote: The Ember Vanguard has a legend now that walks a tunnel ahead of us, and it lies about our height.

subject: Infamous definition clarification
fact: The term 'infamous' was questioned and confirmed to mean 'extra famous' — a bad joke that earned a half-groan.
source_quote: Infamous," I said. "You know that's supposed to mean extra famous.

subject: magic book for Bookwyrm's proof
fact: A magic book will be sought after the fact — to prove Bookwyrm's culpability — to be obtained from the new head of Candlekeep.
source_quote: We use our reward to access the thing that will do her in... the book will come from the new head of Candlekeep.

subject: Kalan's shift from stealth to open confrontation
fact: Kalan changed from covert casting of Zone of Truth to demanding open submission — motivated by fear of future repercussions.
source_quote: I will not sneak this time. We will walk in, and we will boldly demand that she submit to a Zone of Truth.

subject: Thorin's pursuit of physical evidence
fact: Thorin sought physical evidence tying Bookwyrm to placing the heart in the chalice, but was reminded that concealment is not commission.
source_quote: Is there any physical evidence, anything else, we can bring to bear here?

subject: Academic principle vs justice
fact: The group debated whether academic rigor (requiring three evidentiary types) outweighs practical justice (concluding guilt from confession and context).
source_quote: What matters more to an academic? Putting the murderer in jail, or being true to their academic principles and their research proposal?

subject: Gracklstugh posters
fact: Gracklstugh still has the party's name on posters — wrong enough to be cover but their name all the same.
source_quote: Gracklstugh still had our name on posters, wrong enough to be cover but our name all the same.

subject: Janussi's cleaver
fact: The cleaver found with the heart and confession is evidence of cover-up, but not of identity.
source_quote: You have a confession, a heart, and a cleaver. The confession is one spell — the weakest channel... the heart and the cleaver prove someone covered this up cleverly.

subject: Kalan's patient strategy
fact: Kalan advocates patience — letting suspicion and the naming ceremony do the work instead of direct confrontation.
source_quote: Sometimes the clever play is to be patient.

subject: Zalthir's sentence-worrying
fact: Zalthir obsesses over wording — repeatedly questioning how phrases were spoken to extract meaning.
source_quote: Zalthir went back to the wording, which is his instinct — worry the sentence until it gives.

subject: Candlekeep library
fact: A magic book exists in the Candlekeep library that could prove Bookwyrm’s culpability — to be retrieved after the naming ceremony.
source_quote: There's got to be a book somewhere in the library we can use to actually get to the bottom of this.

subject: Kalan's moral compromise
fact: Kalan plans to give Bookwyrm a chance to decline the Zone of Truth — knowing refusal implies guilt, making her politically untenable.
source_quote: We will give her the opportunity to decline. Her declining will further weaken her support among the other Avowed.

subject: Thorin's final solution
fact: Thorin's final solution is to use the reward to obtain a magic book that proves Bookwyrm’s guilt after the fact — avoiding suspicion during the process.
source_quote: We use our reward to access the thing that will do her in. That's much better.

subject: Bookwyrm's chalice
fact: The heart was placed in the chalice of the statue by Bookwyrm — the central act of concealment.
source_quote: We think Bookwyrm extracted the heart and put it in the chalice of the statue, right?

subject: Daz's floor strategy
fact: Daz provides a floor — hacking and slashing — as a fallback when all strategy fails.
source_quote: If things go sideways, we can always start hacking and slashing.

subject: Fembris Lancer's expected election
fact: Fembris Lancer is expected to be elected the new Avowed, replacing Bookwyrm due to suspicion.
source_quote: Fembris Lancer will probably get elected the new avowed.

subject: A'lai's political position
fact: A'lai will not be named the new head of Candlekeep — suspicion extends to him as well.
source_quote: A'lai won't be named either.

subject: The three evidentiary types
fact: The group identifies three elements: confession, heart, cleaver — and debates whether they constitute three types of evidence.
source_quote: You have a confession. A heart and a cleaver.

subject: Alkrist's cell
fact: Alkrist is confined and finished — his confession, the cleaver, and the blood have sealed his fate.
source_quote: Alkrist is finished — his confession, the cleaver, the blood.

subject: Dawnbringer's telepathic communication
fact: Dawnbringer communicates telepathically — her voice clicks inside the speaker’s skull like a palm slapping stone.
source_quote: And then a click inside my skull, a sound like a palm slapping stone, whatever that was supposed to mean.

subject: Thorin's realization of academic irony
fact: Thorin realizes that Kalan’s own academic standard now protects the person they want to convict — the irony is noted.
source_quote: I filed that quietly under the column marked *irony*. The man wrote the standard, and the standard he wrote now shelters the person we most want to reach.

subject: The group's final agreement
fact: The group agrees to hand the case to Kalan, wait for the naming ceremony, and use their reward to obtain a book that proves Bookwyrm's guilt.
source_quote: Alright, so we've got to nail Bookwyrm... We use our reward to access the thing that will do her in.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: one more thing
fact: One more thing happens after she believes she has won.
source_quote: one more thing

subject: potion of flying value
fact: The potion of flying was stolen from the safe and taken by Glabbagool.
source_quote: my Glabbagool arm swipes the potion of flying

subject: red herring coin
fact: One gold coin in the safe had a red herring stamped on it.
source_quote: one of the gold coins had a herring stamped on it, and the herring was red

subject: Deneir's Sanctum
fact: The adventurers were escorted to Deneir's Sanctum to wait out the evening under guard.
source_quote: I will ask him to escort you to Deneir's Sanctum

subject: taster selection
fact: Fembris Lancer was chosen as the taster for the food with the number 118.
source_quote: I'd say 118

subject: sapphire detection
fact: The spell Locate Object found no sapphire on Bookwyrm.
source_quote: I'm hoping she has one on her — that would be interesting. It was not interesting.

subject: safe sealed
fact: The safe was sealed with its contents declared of no interest.
source_quote: They closed the safe with everything still inside... and declared it of no interest.

subject: Kalan reinstated
fact: Kalan Strongbranch was reinstated as head of the Avowed after the investigation.
source_quote: Would you be so willing as to take your position once more?

subject: accusation of accomplices
fact: The group publicly acknowledged the existence of accomplices without naming Bookwyrm.
source_quote: Yeah — we know there are accomplices

subject: Bookwyrm's relief
fact: Bookwyrm was relieved, not heartbroken, upon learning of Alkrist's confession.
source_quote: Alkrist. I could never have imagined it.

subject: Glabbagool's satisfaction
fact: Glabbagool was pleased with the stolen potion of flying and deemed it a good skill.
source_quote: I like the flying skill. That was a good skill.

subject: Alkrist's safe
fact: Alkrist's safe was opened in the presence of the Avowed and found to contain a potion of flying, healing potion, gold, and a red herring coin.
source_quote: A potion of flying. A potion of superior healing. A fat purse of gold coins... one of the gold coins had a herring stamped on it, and the herring was red.

subject: Fembris's punishment
fact: Fembris Lancer was assigned to keep the adventurers company as his penance.
source_quote: Fembris Lancer was already in there, serving out his own punishment by keeping us company.

subject: House arrest avoidance
fact: The adventurers were not under house arrest, but were escorted to Deneir's Sanctum for protection.
source_quote: No, no, no. You currently hold the most important evidence... I'm simply doing this to protect you.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the day of the ambush in Deneir's Sanctum.
source_quote: ## Thorin — Ambush of the Helmed Horrors

subject: helmed horror count
fact: Three helmed horrors are present in the ambush, suits of plate with nobody inside, hovering and drifting, with points of light where eyes should be.
source_quote: Glass and wood came in at the same time, from three directions, and for a breath none of us had moved. "Seems like it's a helmed horror?" ... Suits of plate with nobody inside, walking and — this was the part that made my neck itch — hovering, lifting a hand's width off the floor and drifting. Little points of light where eyes should be.

subject: travel to key location
fact: The key in Daz's pocket is the target of the helmed horrors, drawn to it through plate and pocket alike, with no regard for person or spell.
source_quote: Daz passed the key to Grygum and threw the last of what he had at the one he'd been burning — three darts of light, all home. And the horror turned on a coin and went for Grygum instead... They weren't following a face. They were following the key itself, sniffing it out through plate and pocket both.

subject: Deneir's Sanctum elevation
fact: Deneir's Sanctum is the room where the ambush occurred, with windows shattered and glass on the floor, the ceiling and walls breached by intruding armor.
source_quote: Glass and wood came in at the same time, from three directions... Glass on the floor, dust settling, two dead heaps and one silent inert key three assassins had bled to reach.

subject: key value
fact: The key in Daz's pocket is inert, undetectable by magic, yet irresistible to the helmed horrors, who died to reach it.
source_quote: A key that read as nothing under every spell we'd thrown at it. Dead. Inert. And three suits of murderous plate had come through the windows to die for it.

subject: Dawnbringer value
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient sword that responds to being called beautiful and worthy of study, and its magic slows and destabilizes enemies.
source_quote: Dawnbringer eats it up, I'm sure... a sword that spends its days pointed at fungus and undead, being told at length that it is beautiful, that it is worthy of study — I watched the whole demeanor of the thing open up... I brought her around and caught the one closest to me clean — a real bite, staggering it. Then the sword did its thing: the horror's movements went slow and sloppy, off-balance for its next swing.

subject: lesser restoration usage
fact: A lesser restoration was cast on Daral, removing his sickness and restoring him to health, which he then used to begin research.
source_quote: a lesser restoration I now got to keep in the bank. The blade lit, poured into Daral, and took the sickness with it. He straightened. He breathed. In the space of a heartbeat he was a well man...

subject: Glabbagool acid value
fact: Glabbagool's acid is capable of dissolving plate armor, eating through metal cleanly and leaving rusted wreckage.
source_quote: Glabbagool's last mouthful of acid to go with it. Plate hissed and ran. Their armor was good, real good, and Glabbagool ate a piece of it clean off.

subject: combat outcome
fact: The helmed horrors were destroyed through coordinated attacks using fire, acid, brute force, and tactical positioning, leaving only rusted wreckage.
source_quote: The suit came apart where it stood, and the last of them folded down into piles of rust and loose plate, like they'd never been anything but junk somebody stacked up.

subject: divining rod proposal
fact: A proposal was made to repurpose a destroyed helmed horror as a divining rod to detect others who possess the key.
source_quote: Can we grab one of them and use it to detect who else has the key? I said. Turn it into a sort of divining rod, as it were.
